draft.quote: A drone attack sparked a fire in the port area of Ust-Luga
draft.summary: A drone attack sparked a fire in the Ust-Luga port area, injuring three workers, according to Leningrad region Governor Alexander Drozdenko. Drozdenko said a transformer substation in Ust-Luga had shut down. Bloomberg reports it was unclear whether the attack disrupted oil loadings.
